question: In a certain code language, 'BACK' is coded as '17' and 'DTDC' is coded as '31'. What is the code for 'JAAM' in the given code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : Sum of the position value according to English alphabetic series is written. So, • 'BACK' is coded as '17'
